description: This file defines constants, mappings, and utility functions related to project statuses and project types within the software system.

methods.name: makeDisplayToStatus
methods.description: Creates a map from display status strings to their corresponding integer enums.

methods.name: GetStatusEnum
methods.description: Retrieves the enum integer value for a given display status string, returning an error if not found.

methods.name: invertMap
methods.description: Inverts a map from int to string into a map from string to int.

methods.name: NullUUID
methods.description: Returns a UUID object representing a null or empty UUID.
